g.text: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the four LEDs. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.

g.desc: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the four LEDs. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.

g.text: LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected, so no series diode is needed on the cell (see docs/standard.md section 3).

g.desc: LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected, so no series diode is needed on the cell (see docs/standard.md section 3).

g.text: Here each LED gets its own 1.3 k resistor (about 0.45 mA white on badge power, about 0.2 mA on a fresh cell) and all four are wired the same way:

g.desc: Here each LED gets its own 1.3 k resistor (about 0.45 mA white on badge power, about 0.2 mA on a fresh cell) and all four are wired the same way:

g.text: anode through its resistor to the switched supply, cathode to GND. White through-board LEDs light the four corners from behind.

g.desc: anode through its resistor to the switched supply, cathode to GND. White through-board LEDs light the four corners from behind.

g.text: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.desc: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.text: davedarko's schematic: four LEDs in parallel straight across VCC and GND, no resistor, each lit whenever the board has power.

g.desc: davedarko's schematic: four LEDs in parallel straight across VCC and GND, no resistor, each lit whenever the board has power.
